name: jwt-algorithm-capability-profiles-and-key-4f51
instr:
golang-jwt/jwt cannot inspect JWT algorithm capabilities, preflight keys, or apply one explicit algorithm policy to signing and verification. Add those capabilities.

Every built-in HMAC, RSA PKCS#1, RSA-PSS, ECDSA, Ed25519, and none method must report an independent, mechanics-accurate AlgorithmProfile. Its operation-specific key preflight must not mutate state, sign, or consume randomness. ProfileOf and PreflightKey must not guess capabilities for unprofiled custom methods.

Keep preflight and policy rejections classifiable through errors.Is, retaining the algorithm, operation, and underlying reason. PreflightError matches ErrKeyPreflight; policy rejection matches only ErrAlgorithmPolicy. Preserve distinctions among RSA key roles, PSS salt modes, ECDSA curves and raw widths, Ed25519 key shapes, HMAC byte keys, and none authorization.

Apply AlgorithmPolicy in Token.SignedStringWithPolicy, WithAlgorithmPolicy, and request.WithRequestAlgorithmPolicy before serialization, Keyfunc use, or cryptographic effects. Token.PreflightSigning exposes signing compatibility. Ordinary SignedString and unconfigured parsing retain existing errors, state, precedence, and delegation.

GetAlgorithmProfiles must reflect current registrations through snapshots that cannot mutate later results. Registry, request, CLI, and direct API results must agree. Direct and token HMAC preflight accept byte keys and classify string keys identically. Parser policy rejects prohibited registered algorithms befor
